$sources: NTC-Acero 2017 Sec 3.2 (FR), Sec 5.2 (compression: Rc = χ Fy A FR, χ = (1 + λ^2n)^(-1/n)), Sec 6.3 (lateral-torsional buckling by Mu)
source: NTC-Acero 2017 for the member resistances it sets; connections, bolts, welds and the other member limit states are the parent's AISC 360-22 values

sources.phi: NTC-Acero 2017 Sec 3.2: FR = 0.9 for yielding, buckling and flexure, 0.75 for rupture (the parent's values are the same); the bolt, weld and bearing factors stay the parent's
sources.memberMethods.columnCurve: NTC-Acero 2017 Sec 5.2: χ = (1 + λ^2n)^(-1/n), λ = √(Fy / Fe), n = 1.4 (SAEngine reading for every section; check n of the section types)
sources.memberMethods.lateralTorsional: NTC-Acero 2017 Sec 6.3: Mu of the elastic critical moment with the moment gradient factor C (the program's Cb, at most 2.5: SAEngine practice); MR = 1.15 FR Mp (1 - 0.28 Mp / Mu) <= FR Mp where Mu > 2/3 Mp, else FR Mu
sources.designMethod: NTC-Acero is limit states design only: no allowable stress design (omegaFromPhi none)
